import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_sum_levin_u_workspace structure
class GslSumLevinUWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("q_num", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("q_den", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("dq_num", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("dq_den", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("dsum", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("terms_used", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("sum_plain", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GslSumLevinUWorkspace)

gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslSumLevinUWorkspace)]
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_free.restype = None

def allocate_and_free_workspace(n):
    if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("The size of the workspace must be a positive integer.")

    # Allocate the workspace
    workspace = gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_alloc(n)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate gsl_sum_levin_u_workspace.")

    print(f"Workspace of size {n} allocated successfully.")

    # Free the workspace
    gsl.gsl_sum_levin_u_free(workspace)
    print("Workspace freed successfully.")

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Allocate and free a workspace of size 10
    allocate_and_free_workspace(10)

    # Test case 2: Allocate and free a workspace of size 1
    allocate_and_free_workspace(1)

    # Test case 3: Invalid input (negative size)
    try:
        allocate_and_free_workspace(-5)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "The size of the workspace must be a positive integer."

    # Test case 4: Invalid input (zero size)
    try:
        allocate_and_free_workspace(0)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "The size of the workspace must be a positive integer."

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
